scheduler: arm-specific: Linux or frozen partial observe
runtime_changes: NONE: all B0/R/A binaries and source are immutable; only new harness/documents
fixture_meaning: Historical labels, not unseen heldout data
primary: actual generated tokens / full cohort HTTP wall seconds
clock: time.monotonic_ns around unchanged HTTPConnection request/read/JSON decode
warmup: one identical excluded cohort on each fresh server

bootstrap.quantile: linear interpolation at (n-1)*p, p=.025/.975; random.Random choices within each of h1,h2, reset seed for each campaign-condition

other_verdicts.INCOMPLETE_INVALID: any planned timing visit missing or invalid
other_verdicts.BLOCKED_S_LINUX_ATTRIBUTION_COMPLETE: pre-timing S failure, completed fixed Linux attribution branch
other_verdicts.CONFIRMED_SCOPED_SYSTEM_GAIN_ONE_CAMPAIG: Both A_S/B0_L condition gates pass in one campaign
other_verdicts.COMPLETE_WITHOUT_FULL_SYSTEM_GATE: Complete valid data; full system gate not passed

cpu25.lifecycle: same start before fresh server, READY then explicit 0.5s stabilization; same warmup; stop after server cleanup; <=180s generator

diagnostics.A_pressure: required bounded shutdown evidence, real cost included
diagnostics.watchdog: same 0.5s minimal process/state monitor all arms; existing FULL kernel safety diagnostics for S retained
diagnostics.BPF_inventory: read-only capture before warmup, outside primary clock

environment_allowlist: cases.json server_env replaces parent environment; no parent LLAMA_ARG/LD_PRELOAD/OMP/GOMP/KMP inheritance
invalid_rules: output mismatch against frozen same-fixture B0 oracle
pre/post thermal or resource gate failure
failure_policy: Stop and preserve any invalid visit, no replacement. Pre-timing S admission failure only permits predefined Linux fallback.
smoke: S both cohorts cpu25 admission first; Linux arms both cohorts cpu25 afterward. Each has one warmup plus one excluded check.
auxiliary: process CPU seconds and seconds/token (not energy)
response-defined per-request prompt_n/prompt_ms/predicted_n/predicted_ms; never summed as aggregate throughput
limitations: one new component campaign; historical previously observed fixtures
no fixed6_S or fixed5 arm; no complete interaction or all-static superiority
observe records phases but does not change placement by phase
power_gate: AC online/type fixed; battery charging/full status recorded as observation, not CPU power-source change
ELF_identity: Exact device/inode/SHA256 set, allowing preserved hardlink filenames; actual loaded paths and alias map retained
pre_timing_amendment: admission-v1 stopped before first HTTP generation on pathname-vs-hardlink assertion. Preserve original seal and failure; fix inode/hash matching and duplicate timestamp error handling. No runtime or workload change; 0 timing.

fallback.when: S functional admission blocked before timing only

admission.linux: PASS three arms x two cpu25 cohorts
